# owner of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ownerOf`](gmeow-ownerOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ownerOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/organization`](../../slices/organization.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an agent to something it owns — an organization, an asset, a work. Non-functional and standpoint-indexable (contested ownership coexists, P9). The flat shortcut; promote to an ownership relator (with share, period, jurisdiction) when those matter. Projects to [schema:owns.](https://schema.org/owns.)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the flat fact that an agent owns an entity — an organization, asset, or work — when share, period, and jurisdiction need not be first-class.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it when share, period, or jurisdiction matter (promote to an ownership relator) and avoid forcing one owner — contested and fractional ownership coexist as standpoint-indexed claims ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Assert one [`gmeow:ownerOf`](gmeow-ownerOf.md) triple per ownership; carry contested claims with [`gmeow:accordingTo`](gmeow-accordingTo.md), and reify to an ownership relator when share, interval, or jurisdiction must be borne.
